title: BoJ Minutes — January 21-22, 2027 MPM (the Outlook Report meeting)
source: EST: boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/ ('Monetary Policy Meetings'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its two year tables by this session. Against the header 'Date of MPM | Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', the 2027 January row parses exactly as ['Jan. 21 (Thurs.), 22 (Fri.)', 'Jan. 22 (Fri.)', 'Feb. 1 (Mon.)', 'Mar. 24 (Wed.)'] — i.e. the full Minutes of the January 2027 MPM publish 2027-03-24. The same page states the release time verbatim: 'Note: The time of release will be, in principle, as follows. ... MPM Minutes It will be released at 8:50 a.m.' Filed estimate on two counts, identical to the six BoJ entries already on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:) has FED: for the Federal Reserve and no slot for the Bank of Japan, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep
notes: DISCOVERED during the boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), from the same BoJ table row that dates that release. WHY IT EARNS A SLOT: it makes the late-March 2027 corridor carry TWO BoJ documents rather than one, and this is the RICHER of the two. These are the complete, attributed Minutes of the January 21-22 MPM — a meeting that carried an Outlook Report (boj-decision-2027-01-22, estimate) — published 08:50 JST five days before boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29 (estimate), which is an unattributed digest of the March 17-18 meeting that carried no Outlook. On any information ranking the 03-24 document is the one to read; the calendar previously showed only the 03-29 one, which inverted the ranking by omission. IMPACT IS LOW and the reasoning is measured, not asserted: the sibling ledger parsed all 86 Summaries of Opinions the BoJ has published since 2016 and found the first US session after one moves the S&P 500 0.620% mean absolute against a 0.736% baseline (0.84x — quieter than an ordinary session, n=80), with a 48%/50% coin flip on same-direction-as-the-decision. Minutes are a longer-lagged version of the same genre (61 days here, Jan 22 to Mar 24, vs 11 for the SoO), so if the faster document is a non-event this one cannot be more. symbols is empty, no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed, and the BoJ channel to this calendar's AI names runs through yen funding and global term premium, both second-order for a US equity book and both owned by the FOMC ledgers. ATTRIBUTION NOTE: it lands the day before sifma-bond-early-close-2027-03-25 and two days before good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 plus japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2027-03-26, in a US week shortened to four sessions and carrying quarter-end. Precedent for filing a central-bank meeting-account release as its own entry: fomc-minutes-2026-12-30, ecb-account-2026-10-08 and boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29, all kind 'macro-print'.
